elements.label: Figure 1.17
elements.title: Multiple Ways of Running Cells on Colab
elements.details: Screenshot of the Runtime menu in Colab showing options: Run all (⌘/Ctrl+F9), Run before (⌘/Ctrl+F8), Run the focused cell (⌘/Ctrl+Enter), Run selection (⌘/Ctrl+Shift+Enter), Run after (⌘/Ctrl+F10).
elements.summary: This screenshot illustrates the different menu options available in Google Colab for running multiple cells in bulk or selectively, highlighting common commands like 'Run all' and 'Run before'.
